headline: Daily Rain Muse — Clear Sky in Seattle, WA
poem:
Under Seattle's azure dome, 
Whispers of warmth at 24.1, 
Dreams take flight on winds so free, 
A hopeful sky, a promise to be.
creative_prompt: A vast, clear sky with a few scattered clouds, painting the city below in a warm, golden light as the sun begins its descent, casting long shadows and an aura of serene hope.
